I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. An allotment of land described in below name and depicted in the Surveyor General’s Advance Tracing No. KU/MWT/2022/3667 dated 22.05.2023 situated at Malandeniya Village in No. 655 Kahapathwala North Grama Niladhari Divisional in Mawathagama Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kurunegala District, North Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ - Meegahapitiya - Extent: 0.0281 Hectare North: Meegahapitiya claimed by Rajapakshage Senevirathna; East: Meegahapitiya claimed by Rajapakshage Senevirathna and Ela; South: Meegahapitiya claimed by R. Pabawathi and Road; West: Road and Meegahapitiya claimed by Rajapakshage Senevirathna.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Land.
